svg.title: One request wakes one actor
svg.desc: A client sends one request through kubectl ate proxy to atenet-router. The router calls ResumeActor on ate-api-server, which reads the actor row in Postgres. Below them is one worker pod on the node kind-control-plane. On it, atelet restores the golden snapshot from the object store, and the actor my-counter-1 goes from SUSPENDED to RUNNING. The router then opens a tunnel to the actor. On our x86 server guest the first request took 0.358 s, the next four took 0.062 s to 0.091 s, and a request after 900 s with no traffic took 0.080 s because the actor was still running.
svg.text: THE REQUEST PATH · AGENT SUBSTRATE V1.0.0

g.text: CLIENT TIME THROUGH KUBECTL ATE PROXY, X86 SERVER GUEST

svg.text: after 900 s with no request: 60 of 60 samples RUNNING, then 0.080 s
